description: Evaluation script improvements: centralize shared utilities in diff_utils.py, add METEOR metric, add per-type precision/recall/F1 + confusion matrix, add valid-format rate and McNemar test + per-type breakdown to evaluate.py. Makes both evaluation scripts consistent and adds CommitSuite-comparable metrics.
steps: Step 1 — Centralize TYPE_RE, VALID_RE, extract_type, mcnemar_p in src/commit_model/diff_utils.py. Add them after the existing constants/functions. TYPE_RE = re.compile(r'^(\w+)(\(.+?\))?!?:'), VALID_RE = re.compile(r'^(feat|fix|refactor|chore|docs|test|perf|style|build|ci)(\([\w./-]+\))?!?:\s+\S'), def extract_type(message: str) -> str | None, mcnemar_p copied from evaluate_ollama.py. Update scripts/evaluate.py and scripts/evaluate_ollama.py to import these from commit_model.diff_utils instead of defining them locally.
Step 2 — Add METEOR to pyproject.toml dependencies: add 'nltk>=3.8' to the dependencies list. Also add 'scikit-learn>=1.3', 'matplotlib>=3.7', 'seaborn>=0.12' for steps 3 and 4.

Step 3 — Add METEOR metric to scripts/evaluate.py. At top of file add: import nltk; nltk.download('wordnet', quiet=True); nltk.download('omw-1.4', quiet=True); from nltk.translate.meteor_score import meteor_score. In main(), after computing rouge_score, add: meteor_scores = [meteor_score([r.lower()], p.lower()) for p, r in zip(predictions, references)]; avg_meteor = sum(meteor_scores) / len(meteor_scores). Print 'METEOR: {avg_meteor:.3f}'. Same pattern as CommitSuite/CMG_eval_traditional_metrics.py lines 20-24 but using the existing predictions/references lists.
Step 4 — Add METEOR to scripts/evaluate_ollama.py using the same import and computation pattern. Add 'METEOR' to the score() function dict and the print header.

Step 5 — Add valid-format rate to scripts/evaluate.py. Import VALID_RE from commit_model.diff_utils (after step 1). Add 'valid_format = sum(bool(VALID_RE.match(x)) for x in predictions) / len(predictions)' and print it. This is already present in evaluate_ollama.py; mirrors it in evaluate.py.
Step 6 — Add per-type accuracy breakdown to scripts/evaluate.py. Add a Counter(ref_types).most_common() loop printing per-type accuracy, same pattern as evaluate_ollama.py lines ~130-135.

Step 7 — Add McNemar test to scripts/evaluate.py. Import mcnemar_p from diff_utils. When the --no-adapter flag is False (adapter IS evaluated), both base and finetuned predictions are available; compute and print the McNemar p-value. When --no-adapter is True, skip with a note.

Step 8 — Add per-type precision/recall/F1 and confusion matrix to scripts/evaluate.py. Adapt CommitSuite/Ten-category_eval.py calculate_metrics() (lines 26-58) and generate_confusion_matrix() (lines 61-80). Add: from sklearn.metrics import precision_recall_fscore_support, confusion_matrix; import matplotlib.pyplot as plt; import seaborn as sns. After computing existing metrics, call these functions on predictions/references filtered to VALID types. Write PNG to 'type_confusion_matrix.png'. Print per-type P/R/F1 table. LABELS = ['fix','feat','chore','test','refactor','docs','build','style','perf','ci'] (ordered by test-set frequency from results.md).
acceptance_criteria: python scripts/evaluate.py --no-adapter --test-file data/processed/test.jsonl --limit 10 runs without ImportError (METEOR and sklearn may fail if packages not installed — that is acceptable given bare environment; script must import cleanly and fail gracefully with InstallationError message if dependencies are missing)
scripts/evaluate.py imports TYPE_RE, VALID_RE, extract_type, mcnemar_p from commit_model.diff_utils without error
scripts/evaluate_ollama.py imports TYPE_RE, VALID_RE, extract_type from commit_model.diff_utils without error
pyproject.toml lists nltk, scikit-learn, matplotlib, seaborn in dependencies
verification: python -m unittest tests.test_postprocess -v  (must pass, confirms imports work)
python -c "from commit_model.diff_utils import TYPE_RE, VALID_RE, extract_type, mcnemar_p; print('OK')"  (run from workspace root with src/ on path)
